tool_schemas.name: getUIComponents
tool_schemas.description: Lists Magic UI components in the catalog and returns a cursor-paginated result set ordered by `sort_by`/`sort_order` with up to `limit` items and an optional `cursor` to fetch the next page; filters apply by `status`, `category_key`, full-text `q`, and (when provided) `release_id` to only include components that have an implementation in that release. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any filter, sort, limit, or cursor is invalid or out of range, including an invalid `release_id` format. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when credentials are missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when you lack access to the catalog, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

release_id.description: If provided, only return components that have an implementation in this catalog release.

q.description: Search query applied to component slug and display name.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: getLayout
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Layout category (bento-grid, dock, file-tree, grid-pattern, interactive-grid-pattern, dot-pattern) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are invalid or when `release_id`/`version` is malformed or ambiguous (for example, both provided but not referring to the same release). Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced release does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getMedia
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Media category (hero-video-dialog, terminal, marquee, script-copy-btn, code-comparison) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any filter is invalid or when `release_id`/`version` is malformed or inconsistent (including providing both with a mismatch). Raises NOT_FOUND when the release cannot be found, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed request quotas.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getMotion
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Motion category (blur-fade, scroll-progress, scroll-based-velocity, orbiting-circles, animated-circular-progress-bar) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values or malformed/contradictory `release_id`/`version` inputs. Raises NOT_FOUND if the requested release does not exist, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for authorization failures and RATE_LIMITED for quota enforcement.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getTextReveal
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Text Reveal category (text-animate, line-shadow-text, aurora-text, animated-shiny-text, animated-gradient-text, text-reveal, typing-animation, box-reveal, number-ticker) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are invalid or when `release_id`/`version` is malformed or inconsistent (including mismatched values when both are provided). Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced release cannot be located, and also UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN and RATE_LIMITED when access or quota checks fail.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getTextEffects
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Text Effects category (word-rotate, flip-text, hyper-text, morphing-text, spinning-text, sparkles-text) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid filters or malformed/contradictory release selectors. Raises NOT_FOUND when the target release does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when authentication/authorization or quota rules block the request.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getButtons
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Buttons category (rainbow-button, shimmer-button, shiny-button, interactive-hover-button, animated-subscribe-button, pulsating-button, ripple-button) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values or malformed/inconsistent `release_id`/`version`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the selected release cannot be found, along with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getEffects
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Effects category (animated-beam, border-beam, shine-border, magic-card, meteors, neon-gradient-card, confetti, particles, cool-mode, scratch-to-reveal) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any filter is invalid or when the release selector is malformed or inconsistent (including a mismatch when both `release_id` and `version` are provided). Raises NOT_FOUND when the requested release doesn’t exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN and RATE_LIMITED when the request is blocked by access rules or quotas.

release_id.description: Catalog release id to fetch implementations from.

version.description: Catalog release version to fetch implementations from (alternative to release_id).

tool_schemas.name: getWidgets
tool_schemas.description: Returns the curated bundle of versioned implementation payloads for the Widgets category (animated-list, tweet-card, client-tweet-card, lens, pointer, avatar-circles, icon-cloud, globe) for a specific catalog release selected by `release_id` or `version`, optionally filtered by `framework`, `language`, and implementation `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are invalid or when `release_id`/`version` is malformed or inconsistent, including failing the `release_id` pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced release cannot be found, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when authentication/authorization or quota enforcement prevents the request.

release_id.description: Catalog release ID to fetch widget implementation payloads from.

version.description: Catalog release version string to fetch widget implementation payloads from (alternative to release_id).

framework.description: Framework variant of implementations to return.

language.description: Source language/extension of implementations to return.

tool_schemas.name: getBackgrounds
tool_schemas.description: Provides implementation details for warp-background, flickering-grid, animated-grid-pattern, retro-grid, ripple components.

release_id.description: Catalog release ID to fetch background implementation payloads from.

version.description: Catalog release version string to fetch background implementation payloads from (alternative to release_id).

framework.description: Framework variant of implementations to return.

language.description: Source language/extension of implementations to return.

tool_schemas.name: getDevices
tool_schemas.description: Returns a curated bundle of device component implementation payloads (including safari, iphone-15-pro, and android) for the specified catalog release, filtered by framework, language, and status; the response is a single bundle (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither or both of release_id and version are provided, if release_id does not match the required format, or if framework/language/status are not one of the supported values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced release/version does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access that release.

release_id.description: Catalog release ID to fetch device implementation payloads from.

version.description: Catalog release version string to fetch device implementation payloads from (alternative to release_id).

framework.description: Framework variant of implementations to return.

language.description: Source language/extension of implementations to return.

tool_schemas.name: getCatalogReleases
tool_schemas.description: Lists catalog releases ordered by `sort_by`/`sort_order` and returns a cursor-paginated result set; supports filtering by `status`, `is_active`, and `version`. Returns only releases the caller is authorized to view; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/sorts.

version.description: Filter releases by exact version string.

limit.description: Maximum number of releases to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: createCatalogRelease
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new catalog release in `draft` status. The created release is not active and cannot be activated until it is published and has at least one active component implementation. Returns the created release; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed fields or conflicting version.

version.description: Semantic or vendor version identifier for this release.

source_repo_url.description: Source repository URL the release was produced from.

source_ref.description: Git ref (tag/commit/branch) used to build this release.

tool_schemas.name: updateCatalogRelease
tool_schemas.description: Updates a catalog release by id, including lifecycle transitions (`draft`→`published`, `published`→`deprecated`) and activation. Returns the updated release; refuses with NOT_FOUND when id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, and CONFLICT when attempting to set `is_active=true` while the release is not `published` or has no active implementations.

source_ref.description: Updated git ref used to build this release.

status.description: Set the release lifecycle status. Only allowed transitions: draft→published, published→deprecated.

published_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp to record when the release was published (usually set when status becomes published).

is_active.description: Whether this release is the single active release used by curated category endpoints. Can only be true when status='published' and the release has at least one active implementation.

tool_schemas.name: createUIComponent
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Magic UI component in the catalog. Returns the created component; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed fields and CONFLICT if `slug` is not globally unique.

slug.description: Globally unique component slug (immutable once referenced by any implementation).

repo_path.description: Repository path for the component source.

tool_schemas.name: updateUIComponent
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Magic UI component by id, including lifecycle transitions (`active`→`deprecated`/`hidden`, `deprecated`→`hidden`, `hidden`→`active`). Returns the updated component; refuses with NOT_FOUND when id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, and CONFLICT if attempting to change `slug` after it has been referenced by any implementation.

status.description: Set component lifecycle status (must follow allowed transitions).

slug.description: Component slug. May only be updated if it has never been referenced by any component implementation.
